data.narrative:
ideaForge is a publicly-listed company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, having raised $50M+ to date. The valuation universe consists of seven private companies in the same sector, including Joby Aviation, Archer Aviation, Zipline, Nuro, and Elroy Air. No public comparable companies exist in this narrow market segment.

The Peer-Median method is inapplicable to this valuation. The Drones & Autonomous sector contains only five total comparable companies, and applying standard filters—same stage, adjacent stage, and similar valuation tier—yields fewer than three datapoints in any single filter category, falling below the minimum threshold of three comparables required for statistically meaningful peer analysis. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given ideaForge's specialized subsector focus and the structural differences between drone operators, autonomous vehicle platforms, and delivery networks represented in the broader peer set.

Without sufficient narrow-peer density, traditional triangulation methods cannot be reliably applied to support a valuation range. Key uncertainties preventing analysis include the sparsity of public market benchmarks in autonomous systems, the heterogeneity of business models across the five identified private peers, and the absence of standardized financial metrics across pre-revenue or early-stage autonomous platforms. A valuation conclusion would require either proprietary financial data from comparable companies or an alternative methodology anchored to revenue multiples, unit economics, or technology-specific benchmarks not present in the current dataset.
